# Local HEIC decoder

heic-to 1.6.7, CSP build, unmodified from its npm distribution (LGPL-3.0-or-later), by Hopper Gee.
It runs in a local browser worker. No photographs are sent to any conversion service.
This separate ES module may be replaced with a compatible modified build at the same path.

Source and build instructions: https://github.com/hoppergee/heic-to/tree/v1.6.7
Upstream source: https://github.com/hoppergee/heic-to (release 1.6.7).
Includes libheif 1.23.7 (https://github.com/strukturag/libheif) and libde265 1.0.16 (https://github.com/strukturag/libde265), LGPL libraries; source and build configuration are in the upstream build instructions. License text: heic-to-LICENSE.txt.
